turnaround_reason: SRPT collapsed from ~$130 in 2024 to the mid-teens through 2025 after patient deaths tied to ELEVIDYS gene therapy forced label restrictions, a commercial pause in non-ambulatory Duchenne, and a strategic restructuring. The stock is recovering off a $14.68 low as the label stabilized for ambulatory patients and the company reasserted profitability.
bullish_points: Now GAAP profitable and cash-flow positive: Q1 2026 GAAP operating income of $358M, ~$1B cash on hand, so no near-term dilution pressure
ELEVIDYS retains traditional approval for ambulatory patients and revenue is positioned to re-stabilize; ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 with sirolimus pretreatment is a path back to the non-ambulatory market
Catalyst-rich pipeline: siRNA readouts SRP-1001 (FSHD) and SRP-1003 (DM1), each a >$1B opportunity, flagged by sell-side as potential +25-50% stock moves
Roche partnership on ELEVIDYS ex-US and a broad genetic-medicine platform provide optionality beyond the lead asset
bearish_points: Safety overhang is real and unresolved: the non-ambulatory deaths are the reason for the crash and any further safety signal re-breaks the thesis hard
Revenue fell 34% year-over-year and gross margin printed negative (-17%) on the dossier — the commercial franchise is impaired, not just paused
$1.06B total debt against $788M cash; D/E ~70% leaves less room for error than the cash figure alone suggests
Biotech binary risk: a disappointing siRNA readout removes the main upside catalyst
catalyst: Initial Phase 1/2a data for SRP-1001 (FSHD) and SRP-1003 (DM1), plus progress on the ELEVIDYS non-ambulatory pathway (ENDEAVOR Cohort 8)
catalyst_timing: siRNA initial data expected around Q1 2026 / 1H 2026; non-ambulatory pathway updates through 2026
suggested_trade: Small-to-medium starter spot in the low-$20s; size for binary biotech risk. Consider Jan 2027 calls only for a defined-risk catalyst bet, not core.
key_risk: A new ELEVIDYS safety signal or a failed siRNA readout — either invalidates the recovery narrative
would_skip_if: You cannot stomach single-headline biotech gap risk, or you need confirmed revenue re-acceleration before entering
